answer:
Done — I turned “October budget” into a budget page.

I also cleaned the expense list into a table so the page can update it. The page now shows:
- total spent vs the 15,000 kr limit
- remaining budget and expense count
- spending by category
- recent expenses
- a phone-friendly “Add expense” form that writes new rows back to the note.
